name: Kling AI
shortDescription: AI video generator that makes realistic clips from text or a photo.
bestFor: Realistic AI video clips from a photo or text, at a low price
about: Kling AI makes short video clips from a text description or by animating a photo. It is known for realistic movement and good value, with a free daily allowance.
Creators use it for B-roll, ads, music videos and bringing still images to life.
useCases: Animate a photo into a short clip
features: Text to video and image to video

howToUse.title: Choose image or text to video
howToUse.text: Image to video usually gives more control. Upload a clear photo.

howToUse.title: Describe the movement
howToUse.text: Say what moves and how: "the camera slowly pushes in, her hair moves in the wind".

howToUse.title: Generate and wait
howToUse.text: Generation can take a few minutes. Try a few versions.

howToUse.title: Download and edit
howToUse.text: Download the clip and put clips together in CapCut or another editor.

tips: Describe camera movement (pan, zoom, tracking shot) for more cinematic results.
Keep each clip simple: one subject, one action.
examplePrompt: the camera slowly moves closer as steam rises from a cup of chai on a wooden table, morning sunlight through the window, cinematic
limitations: Free generations are slower and may have a watermark.
Hands, text and fast action can still look wrong.
freePlanDetails: Free daily credits, with slower generation.
pricingNote: US prices. The first month is often discounted. Credits expire each month.

name: Runway
shortDescription: Creative AI video tools for generating and editing video.
bestFor: Filmmakers and creators who want control over AI-generated video
about: Runway is one of the leading AI video companies. Its models generate video from text and images, and it has tools to change the style of a video, remove objects and extend shots.
It is aimed at creative professionals, with controls for camera movement and consistent characters.
useCases: Short film and music video scenes
Change the style of a real video
features: Editing tools such as object removal

howToUse.title: Pick a tool
howToUse.text: Choose video generation, or an editing tool.

howToUse.title: Add an image and prompt
howToUse.text: Upload a starting image if you have one and describe the motion.

howToUse.title: Generate and compare
howToUse.text: Generate a few versions and keep the best.

tips: Start from a strong image: it gives more control than text alone.
Use shorter clips while testing to save credits.
limitations: Credits go quickly: the Standard plan gives under a minute of the top model.
freePlanDetails: A one-time pack of free credits.

name: HeyGen
shortDescription: Makes videos with AI avatars that speak your script, and translates videos.
bestFor: Talking-avatar videos and translating your own videos with lip sync
about: HeyGen makes videos where an AI avatar reads your script. You can use a ready-made avatar or create one of yourself, so you can make videos without filming every time.
It can also translate a video of you into other languages, with your voice and lip movements matched.
useCases: Translate your videos into other languages

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at heygen.com.

howToUse.title: Choose an avatar
howToUse.text: Pick a stock avatar, or record a short clip to create your own.

howToUse.title: Add your script
howToUse.text: Type or paste the script and choose a voice and language.

howToUse.title: Add scenes
howToUse.text: Add backgrounds, text and images for each scene.

howToUse.title: Generate
howToUse.text: Generate the video and download it.

tips: Write short sentences. They sound more natural from an avatar.
Tell viewers when a video uses an AI avatar.
limitations: Free videos are short and limited in number.
Avatars can still look slightly unnatural in long videos.
freePlanDetails: Up to 3 short videos per month.

name: Synthesia
shortDescription: AI avatar videos for training and business, in many languages.
bestFor: Company training and how-to videos with AI presenters
about: Synthesia makes presenter-style videos from a script, with AI avatars in many languages. It is built for businesses, such as training, onboarding and product explainers.
You can edit it like a slide deck, and update a video by changing the text instead of filming again.
useCases: The same video in many languages

howToUse.title: Choose a template
howToUse.text: Pick a template and an avatar.

howToUse.title: Write the script
howToUse.text: Add text for each scene. The avatar reads it.

howToUse.title: Generate and share
howToUse.text: Generate the video and download or share a link.

tips: Break the script into short scenes, like slides.
Use screen recordings in scenes for software tutorials.
limitations: Video minutes are limited each month and don't roll over.
Better for business videos than for entertainment.
freePlanDetails: A free plan with a few minutes of video. Check the website for limits.
pricingNote: US prices. Monthly billing costs more.
